text:
maya: Heads-up — we need to finalize the schema for 'modification assertions' that we stream to the compliance export. Console "who changed X" is slow and doesn't join well to audit rows. Can we agree on one event shape for both realtime UI and bulk exports?

liam: Appreciate the summary. Two quick constraints: 1) UI needs fast actor-resolution (display name + email), 2) exports must be compact for S3/BigQuery. We should avoid shipping full resource blobs.

sophia: +1. Also need an immutable assertion_id so we can reference in rollbacks and incident playbooks.

raj: Proposal: send a single line-per-assertion with diff + minimal context. Fields: assertion_id, actor_id, actor_display, actor_email, timestamp, object_type, object_id, prev_hash, delta (sparse), reason, auth_context (opaque id), sensitive_mask (list of fields masked), exportable:boolean.

elaine: Curious about delta: do we store full previous state for console drilldown? Or reconstruct by replaying events? Replay is slow for UI.

liam: For UI speed we can keep small denormalized snapshots for the last N changes per object (LRU). Exports can remain the single-line assertions — consumers get diffs + snapshot pointer (snapshot_id) if they need full state.

maya: Example line we were thinking for export (ndjson):
```json
{"assertion_id":"as_01F...","timestamp":"2026-06-10T18:12:25Z","actor_id":"u_924","actor_display":"Raj Patel","actor_email":"raj@redwood.ai","object_type":"routing_policy","object_id":"rp_77","delta":{"rules_added":[{"match":"/v1/*","target":"small"}],"rules_removed":[]},"prev_hash":"h_9f3b","reason":"canary rollout","sensitive_mask":["secrets.*"],"exportable":true}
```

raj: That looks good. A few asks: 1) add "service" (which product or console route made the change), 2) add "auth_mechanism" (ui/session/apitoken), 3) make actor_email optional when KMS redaction is on.

elaine: For retention and compliance, exports need TTL metadata and a 'pii_level' tag. We also need a mode to redact email and IPs when exporting to partners.

liam: Implementation notes: streaming path should remain low-latency (pubsub -> transform -> sink). Transform stage will: validate shape, apply pii redaction rules, add snapshot pointer if required, and push to realtime kafka topic for UI and to s3/exports for bulk.

maya: Concern: payload cardinality — some deltas can be large (policy rulesets). We should cap delta size and instead emit a 'snapshot_url' pointing to an encrypted snapshot in S3 (with KMS) when > 64KB.

raj: +1 on snapshot_url. Also we need to version the schema: schema_version, and a compatibility policy in the transform.

elaine: Query UX: Console wants a single 'Who changed this' view that shows nice human diff + link to full assertion and snapshot. That means the UI needs: actor_display, reason, delta_summary (string), timestamp, assertion_id. Everything else can be hidden behind a 'show more'.

liam: Telemetry: emit counters for assertions:size, assertions:masked_count, export:failures to monitor cost/quality. Also sample 1% of full snapshots to BigQuery for trend analysis.

maya: Security note: if auth_context contains ip/session info treat as sensitive by default and strip before external exports. We'll add a 'sensitive_mask' whitelist to the transform config.

deploy-bot: deploy started for audit-transform v2 at commit f4e2a8 — risk: snapshot store migration.

raj: Edge cases: bulk migrations where one API results in 1000 assertions in a second. We should batch flush to S3 and mark export chunks with start/end assertion_id and include chunk_manifest.

elaine: For compliance exports (legal requests) we need an 'export_job' wrapper that can assemble assertions + snapshots for a time window and embed chain-of-custody: export_job_id, requested_by, request_ts, delivered_to.

maya: Action items:
- liam: draft proto/schema + compatibility rules (due EOD Thursday)
- sophia: UI mocks for 'who changed X' and snapshot drilldown (due Tue)
- raj: transform config PR with pii redaction + snapshot cap (open by Mon)
- elaine: compliance export job spec + retention policy doc (start draft)

liam: I'll put a strawman proto in #eng-platform in the next hour.

maya: Thanks, all. If no blockers we'll sync Thurs 11am to finalize shape and rollout plan. :thumbsup:
